description: fx2-cmix sidecar WRT-learn baseline plus a native fxcm context keyed by template-name hash, template argument position, prior byte, and stream class.
deps: C++ runtime for the vendored cmix binary
source_changes: ColumnContext tracks template-name hash and template argument index in the fxcm model.
One fxcm byte context switches from word/bracket context to template position context while inside a template.
verdict: Pruned on the scored 250k gate. The native fxcm template-position context tied the WRT-learn archive but increased counted package size, losing exact S.
